verdict.rationale: The skill ships as its own plugin marketplace (`/plugin marketplace add` plus `/plugin install`), the channel through which marketplace updates would arrive. However, the evidence documents only installation, not updating. The other install routes (copying the folder, uploading a zip, running package_skill.py) imply a manual re-install to get fixes. Missing for 10: any documented update command or auto-update behavior, release or versioning notes, and hands-on confirmation that marketplace updates deliver fixes.
